53
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, March 16, 2017/Phalguna 25, 1938 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Prime Minister; Atomic Energy; Development of North Eastern
Region; Earth Sciences; External Affairs; Housing and Urban Poverty
Alleviation; Human Resource Development; Information and
Broadcasting; Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions;
Science and Technology; Skill Development and
Entrepreneurship; Social Justice and Empowerment;
Space; Statistics and Programme Implementation;
Urban Development; Women and
Child Development)
Total number of questions — 15
Minister's visit to Sri Lanka
*151. SHRI ANUBHAV MOHANTY:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Minister has made an
official visit to Sri Lanka in the recent past;
(b) if so, whether the projects undertaken
by India in that country were also taken up
for discussion during the visit;
(c) if so, which were the projects
discussed; and
(d) the details of all the projects that
India has taken up in that country?
Kendriya Vidyalayas in Andhra
Pradesh
*152. SHRI C.M. RAMESH: Will the
Minister of HUMAN RESOURCE
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the status of Kendriya Vidyalayas
(KVs) in Andhra Pradesh;
(b) whether 315 vacancies of teaching
staff are there in KVs, if so, the details
thereof, school-wise;
(c) since how long they are lying
vacant and the reasons therefor and the
steps taken to fill those vacancies and
by when all the posts are likely to be
filled;
(d) whether the proposals for opening
of new KVs in that State are also lying
pending in the Ministry for clearance;
and
(e) if so, the details thereof and by
when those proposals are likely to be
cleared?

54
Cases of manual scavenging
*153. SHRI VIVEK GUPTA: Will the
Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE AND
EMPOWERMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether the cases of manual
scavenging are still being reported across
the country and if so, the details thereof;
(b) the details of initiatives taken by
Government to rehabilitate those involved
in this work and funds allocated therefor
during the last three years;
(c) whether Government has conducted
any survey to identify the same and if so,
the details thereof; and
(d) the details of deaths reported during
that period due to manual scavenging, State-
wise?
Promotion of clean urban transport
in cities
*154. DR. PRABHAKAR KORE:
Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
promote clean urban transport by building
footpath, non-motorized transport, bus
rapid transit (BRT), etc. in cities;
(b) whether Government also proposes
to promote the use of clean fuel, electric,
hybrid buses and intelligent traffic system
in cities; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and the
categories of cities likely to be covered under
the plan?
Schools for physically challenged
*155. SHRI R. V AITHILINGAM: Will
the Minister of SOCIAL JUSTICE AND
EMPOWERMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government runs schools
for physically challenged and if so, the
details thereof, State-wise as on date;
(b) the details of funds allocated,
sanctioned and utilized for such schools
during the last three years; and
(c) whether Government has any
proposal to establish some more such
schools in the country and if so, the details
thereof?
Establishment of Skills University
*156. SHRI RANJIB BISWAL: Will
the Minister of SKILL DEVELOPMENT
AND ENTREPRENEURSHIP be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the report submitted by the
Working Group for establishment of Skills
University is under consideration of
Government;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
decision taken by Government in this
regard;
(c) whether site selection, modalities,
etc. for the functioning of the University
have also been finalised; and
(d) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor and the details of
progress made, so far, in this regard?
Projects under NLCPR and NEC
*157. SHRIMATI RANEE NARAH:
Will the Minister of DEVELOPMENT OF
NORTH EASTERN REGION be pleased
to state:
(a) the allocations made under the Non-
Lapsable Central Pool of Resources
(NLCPR) and the North Eastern Council
(NEC) during 2016-17;
(b) the amount spent during that period;
and
(c) the number of projects implemented

55
and completed thereunder during the said
period?
Cycling zones and parks under
AMRUT
*158. SHRI MD. NADIMUL
HAQUE: Will the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the number of new cycling zones
and parks created during the last two years
under the Atal Mission for Rejuvenation
and Urban Transformation (AMRUT); and
(b) the details of funds spent during
that period to create new cycling zones
and parks, year-wise?
Brucella-free Villages
*159. SHRIMATI RENUKA
CHOWDHURY: Will the Minister of
SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Department of Bio-
technology has launched Brucella-free
Villages in certain States;
(b) if so, the details thereof

Total number of questions — 160
Plans to increase generation of
atomic energy
1597. SHRI R. V AITHILINGAM: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the country generates the
lowest quantum of energy from atomic
sources;
(b) if so, the details thereof, vis-à-vis
total energy generated domestically; and
(c) the details of plans to increase
generation of energy from atomic sources?
 Construction of US nuclear reactors
1598. SHRIMATI VIJILA
SATHYANANTH: Will the PRIME
MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there is an
uncertainty surrounding the construction
of US nuclear reactors in India;
(b) whether it is also a fact that
Government has been in discussion to build
six AP1000 nuclear reactors;
(c) whether  the Nuclear Power
Corporation of India Limited (NPCIL) has
agreed to work towards finalizing the
arrangements by June, 2017; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Research on cold fusion
1599. SHRI PARIMAL NATHWANI:
Will the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
undertake research in collaboration with
various countries in the field of cold fusion
which could be the ultimate answer to solve
the energy crisis and if so, the details thereof;

371
(b) whether Government is also
encouraging other nationals or university
laboratories to conduct research in the said
field and if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the amount of funds earmarked by
Government for the said purpose?
 MoU with foreign countries for
projects in NER
1600. SHRIMATI SAROJINI
HEMBRAM: Will the Minister of
DEVELOPMENT OF NORTH
EASTERN REGION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has signed any
Memorandum of Understandings (MoUs)
with foreign countries to strengthen various
projects and their implementation in the
States of North-Eastern Region (NER);
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the number of projects related to
development of infrastructure in NER
which are in the pipeline?
 Setting up of weather forecasting
stations
1601. SHRIMATI W ANSUK SYIEM:
Will the Minister of EARTH SCIENCES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the India Meteorological
Department (IMD) has decided to set up
weather forecasting stations in 600 districts
of the country, further to be taken down to
block level;
(b) whether in the first phase of the
proposal IMD has shortlisted around 130
districts;
(c) whether the Krishi Vigyan Kendras
under the Indian Council of Agricultural
Research (ICAR) have been identified as
the possible locations for the proposed
weather forecasting stations; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
 Guidelines for visa for foreign
journalists
1602. SHRI A. VIJAY AKUMAR: Will
the Minister of EXTERNAL AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the guidelines for issuing visa for
foreign journalists;
(b) the number of journalist visas issued
during the last three years, country-wise;
(c) whether Government is aware that
many foreign media organisations are using
Indian journalists for collecting news/
documents; and
(d) if so, the steps taken to ban Indian
journalists to work for foreign media
organisations?
 Fishermen in jails of foreign
countries
1603. SHRI KIRANMAY NANDA:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the number of fishermen imprisoned
in jails of Sri Lanka, Pakistan and
Bangladesh;
(b) whether Government is pursuing
their release;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
 Trade relations with African and
Latin American nations
1604. SHRI SAMBHAJI
CHHATRAPATI: Will the Minister of
EXTERNAL AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has taken
special initiatives for expanding trade
relations with African and Latin American
nations where a lot of potential still exists
despite dominance of Chinese goods and if
so, the details thereof; and

372
(b) the details regarding specific jobs
Indian Embassies and Missions perform in
strengthening trade relations with African
and Latin American countries?
